Hi Maya,

Thanks for taking the SIG for Velocity Health. We ran through your initial questionnaire and have a couple of follow-ups specific to subprocessors and telemetry egress before we complete the Redwood section. Can you provide: 

- A complete subprocessor/vendor roster (cloud providers, telemetry, error monitoring, support tools) with the role each vendor plays and the primary data flows (e.g., user PII, anonymized telemetry, logs). CSV or Google Sheet preferred.
- Any network egress endpoints or IP ranges used by your telemetry vendors (SaaS observability, crash reporting) — our security team maps egress by CIDR where available.
- Contact for procurement if there are any contract redlines or DPA references.

Target for completion on our side: 2026-11-22. If you can share a first-pass roster by EOD 2026-11-18 that would keep us on track. I attached the SIG template we prefer (so you can drop values directly).

Thanks — we know this is a lot during procurement, happy to take the roster in stages.

Best,
Karthik

Thanks Maya and Karthik — quick internal note on how Redwood typically classifies telemetry so we align. Our categories are: 

- Observability (metrics/traces) — Honeycomb, Grafana Cloud
- Error reporting — Sentry (stack traces, error metadata)
- Logging pipeline — Datadog/Elastic (ingest of structured logs)
- Support tooling — Zendesk/Intercom (user-submitted tickets), OpsRunbook contractors (limited access)

For the SIG roster please mark which vendors receive any user-identifiable data vs only aggregated/anonymized telemetry. I've attached our current subprocessor snapshot export for reference — it might speed things up if Velocity maps to our same columns.

Laura / I will reconcile egress IP lists once you share CIDRs; Laura, can you take the action to add the Velocity roster to the shared intake folder when they send it?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 11:04 AM PST Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Maya and Karthik — quick internal note on how Redwood typically classifies telemetry so we align.

Thanks — we've completed a first-pass export and attached the vendor snapshot and a CIDR list for our telemetry vendors. Highlights: 

- Cloud provider: AWS (EC2, S3) — stores backups and customer uploads; no PII in backups per our retention policy.
- Observability: Honeycomb — ingest of traces and event-level metadata (no request bodies).
- Error reporting: Sentry — stack traces + error metadata; configured to scrub request bodies.
- Support: Zendesk — customer-reported tickets (may include PII entered by users).

Attachments: velocity_subprocessor_snapshot.pdf, velocity_telemetry_cidrs.csv

We do have a two-page runbook describing who can access logs and how contractors are vetted; happy to share if that helps your assessment. Also, we require DPAs with all vendors that process PII — procurement copied on this thread for next steps.

Best,
Maya
